dash_ivr_banner_title: 📞 Voice IVR & Dual SMS Autonomous Dispatch Model
dash_ivr_banner_desc: Workers can simply call the SevaSathi toll-free helpline from basic keypad phones, listen to nearby available work, select gigs and schedule dates directly via dial-pad, and instant dual-party confirmation messages are sent to both worker and customer.
upcoming_title: 📞 Voice IVR & Dual SMS Dispatch Model
upcoming_desc: Enabling zero-internet, feature-phone accessibility for all frontline workers. Workers simply call the SevaSathi toll-free helpline, hear live available jobs near them, book directly using their phone dial-pad, select date and time over the call, and instant SMS confirmations are automatically dispatched to both worker and customer.
upcoming_steps_desc: How the automated voice and message dispatch engine connects workers and customers without requiring smartphones, apps, or mobile internet:
step1_desc: A registered worker simply dials the SevaSathi toll-free helpline. The AI IVR identifies their trade, location, and preferred language (English, हिन्दी, বাংলা).
step2_desc: The system reads out nearby open jobs with rates and localities. The worker selects their desired job by pressing the matching number on their dial-pad (e.g. Press 1, 2, or 3).
step3_desc: The worker selects their available service date and time slot right on the call via key-press or voice input. The job is instantly locked and assigned.
step4_desc: Instant booking confirmation messages are simultaneously dispatched via SMS/WhatsApp to both the Worker and the Customer with contact details, address, and verification OTP.
ivr_sim_desc: Simulate a live phone call from a worker without smartphone apps.
sms_stream_desc: Real-time booking confirmation messages dispatched to both phone numbers upon dial-pad confirmation:
inclusion_bullet1: 100% Feature-Phone Support: Works across standard 2G/3G keypad mobile phones.
inclusion_bullet2: Instant Escrow Security: Protects worker wage floor and customer payment through dual-party OTP validation.
